title: Qofa 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti qofa isa tokko dha: 'to be'. Afaan Oromoo keessatti qofookkoo isa lamaa lamaan dha: 'kan' jechuudha 'qabna'. Akkasumas akkamii afaan Ingilizii, afaan Oromoo keessattis qofa 'to be' barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa biraa kan hin kennamne garuu, barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa biraa kan biraa hin kennamneef barbaachummaa fi barbaachisaa biraa kan biraa hin kennamne.
rule: Qofa 'to be' hojii keessatti seenaa lamaa lamaan dha: 'am' (kan 'I' jechuu), 'is' (kan 'he, she, it' jechuu) fi 'are' (kan 'you, we, they' jechuu). Su’ulootiif kennuuf, shamarri godhe: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Dhaga’uuf, 'not' deebi’u: 'I am not', 'he is not' (kan 'he isn't' jechuu), 'they are not' (kan 'they aren't' jechuu).

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromoo keessatti 'Mana dhukkuba' jechuudhaan qofa qabduun hin kennamne garuu, afaan Ingilizii keessatti qofa 'to be' barbaachisaa fi barbaachummaa biraa kan hin kennamneef barbaachummaa fi barbaachisaa biraa kan biraa hin kennamne.

examples.note: Qofa 'is' kan isa ani jechuu hojjetaa.
Shamarri fi qofa godhu su’ulooti kennu.

title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ibsa personal pronouns (yo, tú, él, ella, nosotros, vosotros, ellos) kana hin jiru. Deebii keessatti tokko ilaalchisee Ingilizii keessatti subject (sujeto) malee tokkoof hin qabnu: 'I am tired' (hanga 'am tired' hin jiru). Homaa 'he' fi 'she' hin qajeelfamanu — Ingilizii keessatti biological gender (género biológico), hinishee grammatical gender (género gramatical) kana hin jiru.
rule: Personal pronouns Ingilizii keessatti: I (ani), you (si/sinu), he (isaan), she (isaan), it (kanarraa), we (nutti), they (ismaa). 'It' kanarraa, baasuu fi hinjiruu keessatti qaba. 'You' singular fi plural keessatti qaba. Subject (sujeto) Ingilizii keessatti malee tokkoof hin qabnu.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Qalaa keessatti 'Es profesor' jedhamtu subject (sujeto) hin qabnu, laakin Ingilizii keessatti pronoun (pronombre) barbaachisaa qaba. Malees 'He is...' kana 'She is...' jedhaa ta'u.

examples.note: 'It' kanarraa, baasuu fi hinjiruu keessatti qaba.

title: Articles (a/an, the)
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessumma akkuma afaan Ispeenishii irra deebii qabna: 'a/an' (indefinite) fi 'the' (definite). Fakkeenya uumama tokko akkasii qaba: Afaan Ingilizii irraa harka uumama kana hin qabne (‘Life is beautiful’ jedhama; ‘The life is beautiful’ jechuu hin qabne). Akkasumas, lafa qajeelfama irratti ‘a’ yooki ‘an’ hin qabne: ‘I am a teacher’ (Afaan Ispeenishii irraa ‘Soy profesor’ jedhama; akkuma ‘a’ yooki ‘an’ hin qabne).
rule: ‘A’ dubbii qajeelfama tokko irraa seenaa qabduutti deebi’e; malee ‘an’ dubbii qajeelfama tokko irraa seenaa hin qabneeffatti deebi’e (a book, a car; an apple, an hour — ‘h’ seenaa hin qabne). ‘The’ dubbii tokko irra deebisuu yoo ta’e yooki dubbii tokko irra deebisuu yoo ta’e deebi’e. Uumama amalaa (Love is important, not ‘The love’) irratti ‘the’ hin deebine.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispeenishii irraa ‘Soy profesor’ jedhama; akkuma ‘a’ yooki ‘an’ hin qabne. Afaan Ingilizii irraa lafa qajeelfama irratti ‘a’ yooki ‘an’ deebii qabna.

examples.note: Dubbii tokko irra deebisuu yoo ta’e ‘the’ deebii qabna.

title: Plurales regulares e irregulares básicos
bridge: Afan Oromo, mana baasaa qabaatan akkas ji’an godhi. Ingiliziffa mana baasaa qabaatan -s jechuudhaan godha (book → books), laakin akkas ummi haala malee mirga ittiin qaban: mana baasaa hinneessu -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z jechuu kan danda’an, -es jechuudhaan godhi (bus → buses, watch → watches). Mana baasaa qabiyyee mirga ittiin qaban deebi’an (child → children, foot → feet) kan hinqabne ittiin qaban jechuudhaaf kennu.
rule: Plurales regulares: 1) -s jechuudhaan godhi (cat → cats). 2) Mana baasaa hinneessu -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z jechuu kan danda’an, -es jechuudhaan godhi (box → boxes, dish → dishes). 3) Mana baasaa hinneessu -y jechuu kan danda’an, -y jechuudhaan -ies jechuudhaan godhi (city → cities). 4) Mana baasaa hinneessu -f jechuu kan danda’an, -f jechuudhaan -ves jechuudhaan godhi (wolf → wolves, knife → knives). Plurales irregulares: child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep (hinqabne), fish → fish (hinqabne).

common_error.explanation: Afan Oromo, mana baasaa qabiyyee hinqabne ittiin qaban jechuudhaaf kennu, laakin Ingiliziffa 'child' mirga ittiin qaban jechuudhaan 'children' jechuudhaan godhi. Kana malee, Afaan Ispaanii fayyee mana baasaa qabiyyee -s jechuudhaan godhu akkas ummi haala malee mirga ittiin qaban jechuudhaaf kennu.

examples.note: Mana baasaa hinneessu -x jechuu kan danda’an, -es jechuudhaan godhi.

levels.label: Irregular plurals
levels.translation: Mana baasaa qabiyyee mirga ittiin qaban

title: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, nama adda addaatti dhufan irra deebi’ee hojjetu barrachuu qabnu: 'Yo como pizza todos los días'. Afaan Ingiliffaatti kana malees, fakkeenya guddaa tokko qaba: guyyaa sadan (he, she, it) hojjetaa fiilichi -s guutan (he eats, she works). Haala malees, guyyaa ‘do/does’ barbachuu qabnu akkasumas Afaan Ispaanii keessatti ‘¿...?’ hojjetu godhuuf malee, kana keessatti haqimmatti barbachuu qaba.
rule: Presente simple guyyaa fiilichi sadan (he, she, it) tokkoo keessatti -s guutan (ama -es fiilichi -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z hin kennin) barbaachisaa fiilichi walitti deebisu. Guyyaa ‘do’ (I, you, we, they) ama ‘does’ (he, she, it) fiilichi walitti deebisu akkasumas guyyaa ‘do/does’ + fiilichi walitti deebisu (fiilichi -s hin guutan) barbaachisaa fiilichi walitti deebisu. Fakkeenya: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, guyyaa sadan tokkoo keessatti fiilichi walitti deebisu hin qabne (él come), garuu afaan Ingiliffaatti guyyaa sadan tokkoo keessatti fiilichi -s barbaachisu haqimmatti qaba (he eats). Kana kan arratti Afaan Ispaanii essummaa tokkootti fakkeenyaa isaaniif kennuudha.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.
examples.translation: Isheen kitaabni guyyaa guyyaa barrachuu qaba.

examples.note: 'Does' + guyyaa + fiilichi walitti deebisu (fiilichi -s hin guutan).

translations.om: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)

title: Adverbios de frecuencia (always, sometimes, never)
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, adverbiotsisota maaliifameera ‘siempre’, ‘a veces’ hamaa ‘nunca’ kan hin jiru ‘Yo siempre como pizza’ kana bira keessatti hin jiru. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, simanni waliiwwan qaban: hanga hojii gaafachuu (I always eat pizza), laakiin hojii ‘to be’ biratti (I am always tired). Deebii uumameera qaban yoo ta’e, Afaan Ispaanii keessatti guyyaa sirrii keessatti argamuu danda’u, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti kun hin kennamne.
rule: Adverbios de frecuencia hanga hojii gaafachuu (I always go to school), laakiin hojii ‘to be’ biratti (I am always happy). Guyyaa waliiwwan, guyyaa sirrii biratti hin jiru (Do you always eat breakfast?)

concept_examples.text: I always drink coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz drɪŋk ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: They sometimes go to the cinema.

concept_examples.translation: Kaffalessaa hin baay’ee hunda isaaniif jechaa?

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti ‘Yo siempre como pizza’ kana ‘Yo como pizza siempre’ jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, adverbiotsisota maaliifameera hanga hojii gaafachuu (always eat). Guyyaa sirrii keessatti argamuu Afaan Ispaanii irra deebii keessaa hin jiru.

examples.original: I always get up at 7 am.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɡet ʌp æt ˈsevən æm/

examples.note: Adverbiotsisota hojii ‘to be’ biratti hin jiru.

title: Have got / Has got
bridge: Afaan Ispaaniyitiin, kan arratti kennu malee mootummaa 'tener' itti dhaga'u malee qabna. Afaan Ingilizitti tokko ilaa lamaan: 'have' (I have a car) fi 'have got' (I have got a car). 'Have got' Afaan Ingilizii Baraatiitti argamsiisuudha dhalootaa miti. Maleesuma 'have got' barbaachisaa ta'e jecha ta'ee qaba. Mana qorichaa fi walitti deebii 'have got' malee mootummaa 'have' hin kennan. Fakkeenya: 'I haven't got a car' fi 'Have you got a car?'.
rule: Have got / Has got kan arratti kennu, walitti deebii, saaxiloonni baahi fi barbaachisaa malee qabna. Seerri: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Mana qorichaa: I/you/we/they have not got (haven't got), he/she/it has not got (hasn't got). Gaaffii: Have I/you/we/they got? Has he/she/it got? 'Do/does' hin kennan. Gaaffii sirrii: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Kanarratti barbaachisaa ta'e jecha ta'ee qaba; hojjii miidhaaf kennu 'have' hin qabne.

concept_examples.text: I have got a new phone.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaaniyitti, 'tener' 'have' ama 'have got' jechuu danda'a. SHin 'have got' 'got' jechuun barbaachisaa ta'e jecha ta'ee qaba, 'get' hin jechu. 'I have get' jedhu akkasuma akkuma 'get' jechuu dhihaatanii malee qabna. Fakkeenya: 'have got' barbaachisaa ta'e jecha ta'ee qaba.

examples.original: We have got a big house.
examples.note: 'Have got' kan arratti kennu malee qabna.
Gaaffii 'have/has' fi maqaanii sirrii malee qabna.

title: Preposiciones de lugar (in, on, under, next to)
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, guyyaa lamaaniif adabbiin tokko qabaachuudha. 'In' mana hidhaa qabuu dhiiraa (in the room), 'on' seenaa (on the table), 'under' hojiidhaaf (under the bed) 'next to' akakaa’e (next to the door). 'On the corner' jedhanii 'in' jedhu hinqabne akkasumas dhaga’aa.
rule: Preposiciones de lugar básicas: in (dentro de, en un espacio cerrado), on (sobre, en superficie), under (debajo de), next to (al lado de). Akakaa’e: behind (detrás), in front of (delante), between (entre dos). Afaan Ingilizii Baraatiin keessatti, baasuuf, qaarrisaa dhiiseefi 'on' jedhaa, mana ‘in the car’ jedha’uudha.

concept_examples.text: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The supermarket is next to the bank.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt ɪz nekst tə ðə bæŋk/

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, baasuu dhiiseefi ‘in’ jedheen yaaddessuudhaan, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, baasuu, qaarrisaa fi yaareewwan dhiisuu ‘on’ jedhaa, ‘in’ jedhu hinqabne. ‘In’ mana akakaa’e qabuu dhiiraa (in the car).

examples.original: The milk is in the fridge.
examples.note: Mana hidhaa qabuu dhiiraa ‘in’ jedheen yaaddessuudha.

examples.original: The keys are on the table.
My shoes are under the chair.
The school is next to the church.
examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/
examples.note: Akakaa’e qabuu dhiiraa ‘next to’ jedheen yaaddessuudha.

translations.om: Preposiciones de lugar (in, on, under, next to)

title: Demostrativos (this, that, these, those)
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, ‘kana’ (dhiheessan), ‘kanarra’ (dhiheessan) jechuudhaan qabna. Ingliffa dhiheessan lamaanssa ‘this’ (singular) jechuu ‘these’ (plural) jechuu qabna; du’aniiro ‘that’ (singular) jechuu ‘those’ (plural) jechuu qabna. Kana jechuun Afaan Oromootti ‘kana’ jechuu ‘kanarra’ jechuu hin mi’ina; ‘this’ jechuun dhiheessan lamaanssa ‘that’ jechuun du’aniiro barbaachisaa ta’u godha. ‘These’ jechuun ‘this’ jechuun qopheessuun barbaachisaa ta’u godha.
rule: ‘This’ jechuun dhiheessan lamaanssan singular qabduun barbaadu. ‘These’ jechuun dhiheessan lamaanssan plural qabduun barbaadu. ‘That’ jechuun du’aniiro singular qabduun barbaadu. ‘Those’ jechuun du’aniiro plural qabduun barbaadu. ‘This is my friend’ (dhiheessan lamaanssan) jechuu ‘That is my house’ (du’aniiro) jechuu barbaachisaa ta’u godha.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromootti ‘kana’ jechuu ‘kanarra’ jechuu hin mi’in, laakin Afaan Oromootti ‘this’ jechuun plural qabduun barbaachisuu danda’u, ‘these’ jechuun ‘this’ jechuun qopheessuun barbaachisuu danda’u. ‘This’ jechuun singular qabduu ‘these’ jechuun plural qabduu ta’e jedhi.

title: Can (qabiyyatee fi mirga)
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa, 'can' jedhanii haala malee qabiyyatee ('I can swim') fi mirga ('Can I go?') hin kennine. Kana malees, 'can' hin jiru qabiyyatee fi mirgaa kennu. Guyyaa fuulaa akakaa 'can' guyyaa sadii tokko tokkoo hin jiru (he can, she can) fi 'to' hin barbaadu (I can swim, 'I can to swim' hin jiru). Hanga fuulaa fi hanga gabaabsaa, 'do/does' hin barbaannee, hamma kanaa qabiyyatee fi mirgaa kennu (Can you swim?) yookiin 'not' ergaa (I cannot / can't). Kana verbi modalaa akakaa, verbi baafacha godhatee 'to' hin barbaadu.
rule: 'Can' jedhanii haala malee qabiyyatee (I can play the piano), 2) mirga (Can I go to the bathroom?), 3) haala dhaabataa (It can rain tomorrow) kennu. Guyyaa sadii tokko tokkoo hin jiru. Seensaa: I/you/he/she/it/we/they can + verbi baafacha. Gabaabsaa: cannot (can't) + verbi baafacha. Gaaffii: Can + macaafni guyyaa + verbi baafacha? Cubbamaa tolaa: Yes, I can / No, I can't.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromoo, 'qabiyyatee baqalaa' jedhuu 'to' hin barbaadu. Afaan Ingiliffaa, 'can' jedhanii haala malee verbi baafacha godhatee 'to' hin barbaadu. 'Can to' jedhuu akkasuma hin kennu, want to, need to jedhanii 'to' barbaaduu dhiisuu akakaa.

examples.original: Can they come? Yes, they can.

title: Preguntas con 'wh-' (what, where, who, when)
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, su’uloonni ‘kan’, ‘guyyaa’, ‘qabee’, ‘wanta’ jedhanii akkas su’uloonni ‘what’ (kan), ‘where’ (guyyaa), ‘who’ (qabee), ‘when’ (wanta) dubbatanis hin jiru. Akkas godhataa: Su’uloon wh- + am/is/are + macaafni + haala dhaabbataa? Fakkeenya: ‘Where do you live?’ (Guyyaa kee ta’ee?). Afaan Ispeenichaa tokko qofa hin barbaadu ‘do/does’ su’uloonni dubbatuu dhiisuu fi su’uloonni hin jiru godhataa hin kennamuu (fakkeenya: ‘Can you tell me where the station is?’ – adabii, ‘where is the station’ jedhu hin godhin).
rule: Su’uloonni wh- akkas godhan: 1) Verbo ‘to be’ tokko: Su’uloon wh- + am/is/are + macaafni? (Where is the bank?). 2) ‘Can’ tokko: Su’uloon wh- + can + macaafni + haala dhaabbataa? (What can you do?). 3) Dhaabbataa baafachuu (haala dhaabboota): Su’uloon wh- + do/does + macaafni + haala dhaabbataa? (What do you eat?). 4) Su’uloonni hin jiru (‘Can you tell me...’, ‘Do you know...’), godhataa macaafni + haala dhaabbataa: ‘Can you tell me where the station is?’ (‘where is the station’ jedhu hin godhin).

common_error.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
common_error.correct: Can you tell me where the station is?
common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispeenichaa, su’uloonni hin jiru godhataa su’uloonni dubbatuu akkas godhamu: ‘¿Puedes decirme dónde está la estación?’. Afaan Ingilizii, su’uloonni hin jiru godhataa macaafni + haala dhaabbataa, godhataa hin kennamuu. Kana Afaan Ispeenichaa tokko qofa hin barbaadu.

title: There is / Yoo malee
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii, "there is" (kanarra) fi "there are" (sadii) seeraatiin qaban. Akkasumas, "yoo malee" jedhanii wajjin tokko kan ta'e jechuuf argisiisu. Fakkeenyi: 'There is a book on the table' (Yoo malee kitaaba tokko dukkana keessatti jira), 'There are two books on the table' (Yoo malee kitaabota lallattoo dukkana keessatti jiran). Akkasumas galatee keessatti argisiisu: 'Is there a bank near here?' fi 'Are there any restaurants?'. Afaan Isbaanichitti dubbifama qabdu kanarraa fi sadii "there is/are" fi "have" hin kennamneef kennuudha. Mana fakkeenya: 'The house has a garden' jechuu mannaa, 'There is a garden in the house' jedhaa ta'u malee.
rule: 'There is' kanarraa fi qindeessan (There is some water) jechuuf argisiisu. 'There are' sadii qindeessan (There are three chairs) jechuuf argisiisu. Galatee keessatti: Is there...? / Are there...? Gaggummaa keessatti: There isn't / There aren't. Akkasumas 'any' galatee fi gaggummaa keessatti argisiisu: 'Is there any milk?' (Manaa baanaa jira?) fi 'There isn't any milk' (Manaa baanaa hin jiru).

concept_examples.text: There is a cat in the garden.
concept_examples.translation: Yoo malee barsiisa tokko baafata keessatti jira.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə kæt ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːdən/

concept_examples.text: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
concept_examples.translation: Yoo malee seexa lallattoo matii keessatti jiran.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr tuː tʃeəz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/

concept_examples.text: Is there a bank near here?
concept_examples.translation: Yoo malee baanka tokko inni keessumaa jira?

concept_examples.text: There aren't any students in the class.
concept_examples.translation: Yoo malee mana barumsa hin jiran manaa qaxxaawwan keessatti.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn ðə klɑːs/

common_error.wrong: In my house have a garden.
common_error.correct: There is a garden in my house.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Isbaanichitti, 'Mi casa tiene un jardín' jedhuu mannaa, 'tener' jechuun argisiisu. Afaan Ingiliffii garuu, jiraatanii kanarraa fi sadii 'there is/are' jechuun argisiisu, 'have' hin jechuu. Kana malees, akkuma jiraatanii afaan Isbaanitti deebii akkamii dubbatan irra deebisuudha.

examples.original: There is a phone on the desk.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə fəʊn ɒn ðə desk/
examples.translation: Yoo malee telefoni tokko dukkana keessatti jira.

examples.original: There are three cars in the street.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr θriː kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/
examples.translation: Yoo malee mootorri lallattoo ibsa keessatti jiran.

levels.label: Questions with Is there / Are there

examples.original: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈeni eɡz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Yoo malee baaccata manaa kulinaa keessatti jiran?

examples.original: There isn't any sugar in the cupboard.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ˈɪzənt ˈeni ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈkʌbəd/
examples.translation: Yoo malee surka manaa qaxxaawwan keessatti hin jiru.
